notes.title: PATCH 5.4.0
notes.notes:
Its ONE WEEK FROM CHRISTMAS and here's a little patch update for WHAT THE CAR? 

Go sit somewhere cozy and imagine a lively fireplace, or just like, open a YouTube video with one and take a skim through the report ⏬

[h1] 🛠 CHANGES AND FIXES SUMMARY 🛠 [/h1]

[list]
[h3]OVERWORLD[/h3]
[*] Fix for not being able to complete 'The Gang's All Here' achievement. This means that current live users who have 7/8 characters will get the achievement next time they appear in the home hub.
[*] Fuse from the Frogger level in the swamp finishes in the middle of nowhere
[*] Fixed glitching Dialogue Alert Icon
[*] Community Level Bug in License to Car / Removed the extra crown pad in the book
[*] Certain cheering bears appear green when you unlocked them after the elevator. They are a normal bear-brown now.
[*] New elevator: Car got tossed too far when exiting the elevator under certain conditions. Now it gets tossed a normal amount.
[*] New elevator: Fixed overlapping text in certain languages
[*] Ice week 2024: Sign at elevator had overflowing text in a certain language
[*] Swamp skull level: Got boosted the wrong place after skull level.
[*] Cable from generator was clipping under the ground in every overworld
[*] Hallo-wheels Hunt: removed Z fighting on the ground at the elevator
[*] Fixed issues with the duck displayed on a screen in the ... goose... mini-game found in Episode 5: DRIVING

[h3]LEVELS[/h3]
[*] In CAR NEEDS AN ICEBREAKER the button was for 'HONK' but the action was jumping - now it matches!
[*] Certain bike stages have low FPS and stutters on Steam Deck; this should be adjusted now!
[*] JUMP THE ROPE level: trees were blocking the view of the car in the end shot. Can't mess up the money shot!
[*] The wire keeping the big cranes in CAR WITH LARGE LEGS onboarding did not rotate with the crane itself. Rotate enabled.
[*] A couple of things were floating in the last onboarding level. Get dun. 
[*] Ice week 2024: Players were able to get stuck in a gap in the stage CAR NEEDS AN ICEBREAKER - patched this.
[*] Ice week 2024: Certain intro words were not pronounced correctly
[/list]

We keep an eye on any feedback regarding difficult times or potential cheating, so give us a shout here on the community page or on Discord and we'll take a look!

You can also report bugs right here on Steam (Steam Community) or on our [url=https://discord.gg/triband]Discord[/url] at #car-bugs. Our bug-bears read them all the time and catch up as soon as possible! <3

Remember when reporting bugs, please add what device you're on and some clear description of the issue (picture or video helps a lot)

MERRY WHEELSMAS & HAPPY HONKS,
- Sarah (Community Manager)

notes.title: PATCH 5.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello dear car-nnoisseurs!

Here's some exciting patches, bug fixes and QoL updates for WHAT THE CAR? 🌟

Take a deep breath, find a comfortable way to sit, stand or float in the air and then take a read through the report ⏬


[h1] 🛠 CHANGES AND FIXES SUMMARY 🛠 [/h1]
[h2]Updated Content / Quality of Life changes[/h2]
[h3][b]CHANGES TO TUTORIAL AND EPISODE 1[/b][/h3]
The tutorial levels are now:
[list]
[*] JUST A NORMAL CAR?
[*] CAR WITH LEGS
[*] CAR WITH TOO MANY LEGS
[*] CAR WITH JUMPS
[*] CAR WITH VERY LARGE LEGS
[*] BEAR WITH ME
[/list]
Each of these have gotten a new make-over visually and we tweaked the controllers.
[list]
[*] There’s a new transition scene between tutorial and the first episode ⭐
[*] Certain levels have been removed from Episode 1 and integrated into the Tutorial instead 
[*] New decorative scenarios and dialogue added to the surroundings in Episode 1
[*] Changes to the navigation of Episode 1
[*]  New UI for dialogues alert (see bottom gif for example)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/6e019053fb6dcccdd6efd45bb64f0bcdd02e0329.gif[/img]

Part of this is also the transition between the episodes! Now, instead of getting a bear on top of CAR and this bear unlocking the computer to the next episode, it does so right away, with the new Episode Elevator!

[h3][b]THE ELEVATOR[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New ‘Episode Elevator’ - a much quicker way of navigating between episodes. Enter the Elevator and scroll to select the Episodes as they unlock!
[*] New Hypezones for each Episode, now in the main room 
[*] It also gives an overview of which levels you have completed and what kind of crown you got in the Episodes 👑
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/df47df77da0a8aa673cc2fa9a337976a91014874.gif[/img]

Edit: Yes, this means some of the secrets of the dungeon travel has been moved... Time to find the new spots 👀

[h2]Issues fixed[/h2]
[list]

[*] [h3]Did you have trouble publishing a level?[/h3] You should be able to let loose your creations into the world now! (Please let us know if this is not the case after downloading the update!)

[*] The was a paint splatter drawing issue in the Party Episode - you should be able to draw as many… bananas… as you want now!
[*] Fix to the navigation in Episode 3: WORKING, where certain spawn points would lock you if you jumped off the train. 
[*] Fix to make it easier getting to the SKULL LEVELS in Episode 3: WORKING via the train
[*] Fix on a paper trail from a certain prop in A-maze-ing Weekend Event
[*] Fix Ghost Trail in Hallo-wheels Event
[*] Fix with HONKING mechanic in certain dialogue scenes
[*] Fix of Level UI being stuck after save resets
[*] Fix with names of Remix Levels on top of leaderboards
[*] Fix the dial size on episode selection
[*] New bear dialogue at the end of the Party Episode
[*] Fix bug where elevator bear would be invisible in unlock sequence
[*] Fix to remove conveyor belt
[*] Fix to UI of pages in the Card Book 
[*] Fixed shiny material (it’s NOT shiiineeyy ✨)
[*] Removed bananas from Screen Falling animation
[*] Checked cell overload before releasing a prop from a Move Car in the Level Maker
[*] Moved the Guide Bear position
[*] Fix to animator for bear on the horsespring Jump Hypezone
[*] Fixed error for build tests
[*] Fixed bug where remix pads would show as completed with the same crown as their original level, even if player had not played any remix
[*] Added CAR WITH LARGE LEGS palette in Episode 1
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/1af8c05e8ae8fa952667b563840e6cbcc5b609eb.gif[/img]

We're constantly working on how to improve people's experience in WHAT THE CAR? and listen to your feedback 👂So please let us know what you think, yay or nay, we want to hear it! You can write right here, make a whole post or poke us on Discord. 

You can also report bugs right here on Steam (Steam Community) or on our [url=https://discord.gg/triband]Discord[/url] at #car-bugs. Our bug-bears read them all the time and catch up as soon as possible! <3

Remember when reporting bugs, please add what device you're on and some clear description of the issue (picture or video helps a lot)

HAPPY HONKS,
- Sarah (Community Manager)

notes.title: HOTFIX 4.5.2
notes.notes:
Hope you've all had a nice weekend! CAR and the bears have been off on shenanigans.

Y'all are ENERGETIC about reporting bugs so we've done a second pass over the things you've spotted! Grab a nice drink and have a skim through the report.



[h1] 🛠 HOTFIX SUMMARY 🛠 [/h1]

[list]
[*] Specials and dailies didn't get counted towards their achievements; this should be corrected now! Go get those achievements, gang!
[*] Remix UGC pads in specials don't show crowns for completion. You dropped this, king 👉👑
[*] The bear at the start of Wind Special update has its speech bubble disappear right away. Let him speak!!!
[*] In Episode 4: LONGER you can spawn after a closed barrier. Oopsie
[*] SteamDeck: UI was scaled too small 🤏 Should be easier to read now!
[*] Jumping on top of building for gold shortcut in the skull level Escape Car-tist was too unreliable. RIP to everyone who went for this before the patch 💀
[*] Getting the card on top of tent of DO CARS DREAM OF GIRAFFE WHEELS? required too much acrobatics. The giraffes should be slightly easier to wrangle now. Just slightly. 🦒
[*] In Episode 1: JUMPING you could skip the barrier by falling in the water. We've put baby railings up now.
[*] In THEY SEE ME ROLLING you lost all your NYOOMENTUM when entering a road. That felt bad. It should be rolling better now. 👩‍💼
[/list]

As part of the fix, we've also adjusted the difficulty in getting gold in some levels, overall. This round was particularly focused on the Sas-Car levels! We listen all the time to your feedback on all levels, so please let us know (either here or on Discord) and we'll dig back into others too!

You can either report bugs right here on Steam (Steam Community) or on our [url=https://discord.gg/triband]Discord[/url] at #car-bugs. We're reading them erry week, and catch up as soon as possible! <3

Remember when reporting bugs, please add what device you're on and some clear description of the issue (picture or video helps a lot)!

[url=https://discord.gg/triband]

notes.title: What The Car? gets a free demo and September 5th release date
notes.notes:
Today is Tuesday, statistically the day of the week least rife with wacky hijinks, whimsical calamity, or even, dare I say, madcap antics. However, if you want to buck tradition, you could do worse than playing What the Car?, the upcoming absurdist physics game from What the Golf? and What the Bat? devs Triband. You can do it right now, actually. It’s just gotten a free demo on Steam, alongside a proper release date of September 5th 2024. Don’t do it if you’re actually driving, though. That’d be lunacy. We only promote the fun kind of lunacy here, like the type shown off in What the Car?’s trailer at the Triple-i initiative.
